games.title: Tiny Village
games.description: Tiny Village is a cozy pixel-art farming and village-building game. Start with one small house, explore a large world, collect resources, farm, fish, mine, buy and sell items, earn money, and slowly build your own growing village. 🌱🏡

games.title: Fruit Merge
games.description: Drop, merge, and grow the ultimate watermelon! 🍉 A cozy physics puzzle game where you drop colorful fruits and merge same ones into bigger fruits. Simple, satisfying, and addictive — easy to learn, hard to master.

games.title: Car Goods
games.description: Get behind the wheel and deliver goods across a 3D world! 🚚 A single-player driving game where you drive, transport cargo, and master the roads. Test your driving skills and complete delivery challenges.
